**The Spec, SDD and Tasks tabs read a change from the worktree when main has none (#1276)**

What: one pickTabSource choice walks main HEAD, then the single local worktree that holds the change dir, then the origin branch that holds it (the open PR head wins when several do; with no PR the tabs refuse and name them), and feeds the Spec, SDD and Tasks tabs plus the documents map; each tab states its source ('from worktree <leaf> · <branch>'); an unread step stops the walk and says why, never falling through to origin; a modified worktree tasks.md is blamed with git blame --porcelain --contents - on the served root's git, an untracked one runs no blame. A repository with no openspec/changes now has an ok, empty changes section, so a first change that lives only in a worktree still shows. Why: after #883 the maintainer found the SDD tab still empty, because #883's D76 kept the tabs on main and put worktree documents in a separate block. Learned: a design note conditional on the maintainer's intent must be asked before apply; treat a missing dir as empty at the data source rather than matching ENOENT text downstream; a headless test selector that misses is not a UI bug (undeclared tiles are clickable; the lane is paged 24 per page).
